bias.zh: 反弹 · 回到 10 日均线，仍低于 $1,531

read.en: ASML fell 2.4% on Nov 12 to $1,497.12, trading $1,487.85–1,530.95. It sits on the 5-day ($1,495.5) and 10-day ($1,497.5) and below the 30-day ($1,632.0), 100-day ($1,709.9) and 200-day ($1,602.0); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($1,367.05), and RSI is 42.3.

The pullback lost the $1,515–1,531 support (Nov 11 and Jul 29 lows), now resistance; the $1,487.85 low held above $1,479. Resistance is $1,507.9–1,531, then $1,545.7–1,547 and $1,572.8–1,575.6. Support is $1,479–1,495.5 (5-day, Nov 12 and Nov 4 lows), then $1,443.5–1,468 (Nov 9 low, Nov 5–6 highs) and $1,367 (SAR). A close above $1,531 would target $1,546–1,547; below $1,479, $1,444–1,468.

r.en: 10-day average $1,497.5; Nov 10 close $1,507.85; Nov 11 low $1,517.11; Jul 29 low $1,530.64, lost
